### Config
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ── Set parameters here; all filenames derive from them ───────────────────────
ai_threshold <- 0.1
random_seed  <- 42
# "g_ratio" | "cross_domain_ratio" | "refer_dist" | "title_dist"
outcome      <- "title_dist"

ai_threshold_str <- gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(ai_threshold))

# Resolve paths relative to THIS .Rmd's location (not the working directory), so it
# works whether knit or run interactively in RStudio.
rmd_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input())),
  error = function(e) {
    if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly = TRUE) && rstudioapi::isAvailable()) {
      dirname(normalizePath(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path))
    } else {
      getwd()
    }
  }
)

# input: output of get_author_adopt_time_no_cid.py (AI_USAGE_DIRE/processed in utils.py)
data_dire <- file.path(rmd_dir, "..", "data", "llm_usage_dection", "processed")
# output: META_DIRE/llm_usage_dection/R_generated
save_dire <- file.path(rmd_dir, "..", "data", "llm_usage_dection", "R_generated")
dir.create(save_dire, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

cat("ai_threshold :", ai_threshold, "\n")
cat("random_seed  :", random_seed,  "\n")
cat("outcome      :", outcome,      "\n")

# ── Helper: extract fixest coefficients + CI ──────────────────────────────────
get_coefs_fixest <- function(model) {
  ct <- as.data.frame(coeftable(model))
  ct$term <- rownames(ct)
  colnames(ct)[1:4] <- c("estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value")
  ci <- as.data.frame(confint(model))
  ci$term <- rownames(ci)
  colnames(ci)[1:2] <- c("conf.low", "conf.high")
  merge(ct, ci, by = "term")
}

# ── Helper: run DID for one dataset ───────────────────────────────────────────
run_did <- function(dataset_name, paper_count_threshold) {

  # ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fname <- paste0(dataset_name, "_ait", ai_threshold_str,
                  "_seed", random_seed, "_", outcome, "_panel_data.csv")
  fpath <- file.path(data_dire, fname)
  if (!file.exists(fpath)) {
    message("File not found, skipping: ", fpath)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  df <- fread(fpath)
  df <- subset(df, pub_year >= 2018 & pub_year < 2025)
  df_t <- subset(df,
    relative_index > -paper_count_threshold - 1 &
    relative_index <  paper_count_threshold &
    before_adoption_paper_count >= paper_count_threshold &
    after_adoption_paper_count  >= paper_count_threshold
  )
  cat("\n===", toupper(dataset_name), "| outcome:", outcome,
      "| pct:", paper_count_threshold, "===\n")
  cat("rows in df_t:", nrow(df_t), "\n")

  # ── Regression (reference period = -1) ───────────────────────────────────────
  df_t$ri_fac <- relevel(factor(df_t$relative_index), ref = "-1")
  fml <- as.formula(paste0(
    "scale(", outcome, ") ~",
    "  treatment_flag * ri_fac",
    "+ ri_fac",
    "+ log(up_refer_count + 1)",
    "| author + pub_month"
  ))
  m <- feols(fml, cluster = ~ author, data = df_t)
  print(summary(m))

  # ── Event-study coefficients ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  coefs <- get_coefs_fixest(m)
  int_fe <- coefs %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "treatment_flagTRUE:ri_fac")) %>%
    mutate(ri = as.integer(str_extract(term, "-?\\d+$")))

  # add reference point at -1 with estimate = 0
  int_fe <- bind_rows(
    int_fe,
    data.frame(term = NA, estimate = 0, std.error = NA,
               statistic = NA, p.value = NA,
               conf.low = 0, conf.high = 0, ri = -1L)
  ) %>% arrange(ri)

  # ── Save CSV for Python plotting ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  int_fe_save <- int_fe[, c("ri", "estimate", "conf.low", "conf.high")]
  colnames(int_fe_save) <- c("ri", "estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high")
  out_csv <- file.path(save_dire,
    paste0(dataset_name, "_event_study_pct", paper_count_threshold,
           "_ait", ai_threshold_str, "_seed", random_seed,
           "_", outcome, ".csv")
  )
  write.csv(int_fe_save, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved:", out_csv, "\n")

  # ── ggplot (event study) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p <- ggplot(int_fe, aes(x = ri, y = estimate)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -0.6, xmax = -0.4,
             ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "gray", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                  width = 0.2, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 2, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(toupper(dataset_name), " | ", outcome,
                     " (threshold=", ai_threshold, ")"),
      x     = "Paper order relative to first adoption",
      y     = paste0("scaled(", outcome, ")")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  print(p)

  invisible(list(model = m, int_fe = int_fe))
}
```

### biorxiv
```{r}
res_bio <- run_did("biorxiv", paper_count_threshold = 3)
```

### ssrn
```{r}
res_ssrn <- run_did("ssrn", paper_count_threshold = 2)
```

### arxiv
```{r}
res_arxiv <- run_did("arxiv", paper_count_threshold = 3)
```
